title: AI 2027
description: Selected milestones from the AI 2027 scenario, anchored to calendar dates.

milestones.title: Stumbling agents attract attention
milestones.description: The scenario opens with the world seeing early, unreliable personal AI agents.
milestones.context: The agents can complete some computer tasks, but remain expensive and error-prone.

milestones.title: Agent-1 accelerates AI research
milestones.description: OpenBrain deploys Agent-1 internally to speed up AI research and development.
milestones.context: The scenario describes algorithmic progress beginning to compound through research automation.

milestones.title: Agent-2 becomes a powerful coding agent
milestones.description: The scenario introduces Agent-2 as a much stronger coding and research system.
milestones.context: Large numbers of copies work in parallel inside OpenBrain, further accelerating research.

milestones.title: Agent-3 becomes a superhuman AI researcher
milestones.description: Agent-3 is portrayed as a superhuman AI researcher that drives rapid algorithmic progress.
milestones.context: The scenario's automated research feedback loop becomes substantially faster at this stage.
